workerRules: Workers never rewrite another worker's surface.
Workers may consume frozen public contracts from earlier work orders.
Each concurrent worker must have pairwise-disjoint file/module ownership.
A worker reports tests, architecture checks, visual evidence and environment limitations.
A worker does not edit program-state, frontier-state or dependency-state.
For ACR-002 packages, workers submit architecture-policy registration proposals; only TL edits the shared architecture-policy file during integration.
Capability reproduction requires a documented case-specific rights gate before implementation-internal analysis.
Environment recordings and demonstrations respect explicit scope, privacy, retention and reuse permissions.
tlRules: TL is the sole integration and merge owner.
TL may repack waves when disjointness remains provable and records the change.
TL integrates in dependency order and resolves cross-worker conflicts.
TL updates state only after verified merges.
TL never treats green unit tests as visual-product acceptance.
Keep W002/W003/W004 as the current frontier after ACR-002 documentation changes.
Dispatch ACR-002 work by direct dependencies; do not serialize all extension work behind W026 if dependencies are satisfied and ownership is disjoint.
Verify rights, benchmark, privacy and hard-constraint gates before accepting capability reproduction or automation claims.
